data.name: BAUSFIGHT
data.detailed_description:
BAUSFIGHT is the ultimate pixel-art battleground! Dive into a fast-paced, top-down multiplayer arena where survival demands quick reflexes, precise positioning, and mastering unique character classes.

WORK IN PROGRESS: Join the Discord server to participate in upcoming closed playtests and shape development!

You can find it in right bottom Socials section

CORE FEATURES

  • Play With or Against Friends/Randoms: Take full control of how you match up. Instantly host your own public or private Steam lobby to settle scores with your crew and other players, or browse and jump into active sessions from the in-game menu to test your skills against randoms.

  • Distinct Character Classes: Play your way. Choose from unique classes featuring specialized active abilities, movement mechanics, and traits to outsmart your opponents.

  • Stylized Cosmetic Loot: Stand out in the arena! Unlock and equip a massive variety of skins, vibrant weapons and charming companion pets.

  • Pure Retro Vibes: Enjoy highly responsive, real-time physics PvP combat wrapped in beautifully stylized pixel art.

GAMEPLAY MODES (IN DEVELOPMENT)

Unique Game Modes: Experience combat across multiple game types:

  • FFA (Free For All): Every one for himself. Will later turn into Battle Royale with more features.

  • The Pits: Engage in high-stakes, rapid, best-of-X skirmishes. 1-4 squad size.

  • Capture the Flag: Coordinate with your team to secure objectives while defending your own base. 1-4 squad size.

  • Battle Royale: Fight for survival in up to 24-player elimination matches, 1-4 squad size.

  • Singleplayer campaings

data.short_description: BAUSFIGHT is a fast-paced battleground for 2–8 players, packed with short multiplayer modes. Choose a weapon-based class, master its unique abilities, and unleash wild combos to ruin your foes’ day. Fight solo to be the last one standing, or team up with friends and conquer the lobby together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection recommended for optimal multiplayer matchmaking performance.
